extracted.name: Breakfast Banana Green Smoothie
extracted.description: Spinach, banana, and carrot provide a wealth of nutrients to this smoothie recipe for a quick breakfast option when adjusting to your back-to-school schedule!
ingredient_lines: 2 cups baby spinach leaves, or to taste
1 carrot, peeled and cut into large chunks
0.75 cup plain fat-free Greek yogurt, or to taste
instruction_lines: Put spinach, banana, carrot, yogurt, ice, and honey in a blender; blend until smooth.
